Services

I do my best work when I’m working within a dynamic, diverse team that loves to take ownership and share information. I thoroughly enjoy building connections and working across functions as I find this provides the opportunity to cross-pollinate ideas and better understand the user journey as a whole, as well as the impact each channel has on this journey.

So, how can I help?

I’m the right fit for you if you require someone to coordinate, organize and manage campaigns & projects from inception to delivery and optimization. I’ll make sure all parties are aware of the part they have to play and work with different stakeholders to ensure everyone owns and is accountable for their work, also ascertaining that they feel the timelines are fair, their input can be measured, and that we’re working together towards the same goals. Here are some areas I can support;

Social Media Strategy & Management
Content Strategy, Management & Creation
Briefing and project managing 
Content localization 
Testing & Improving Processes
Working with different teams to align functions 
Helping with the implementation of marketing strategies 
Liaising with both internal and external stakeholders to keep things aligned and projects moving forward 
Help identify responsibilities, deliverables, and deadlines for each team
Finding solutions to challenges

Languages

Tools

Recommendations

I don’t particularly enjoy talking about myself, which is why I used recommendations and references I received throughout my career to build the entire content of this site. I find these words humbling and I’ll be forever grateful that I crossed paths with so many brilliant people. These recommendations fill me with pride because each of these people have remained my personal friends, even though we stopped being colleagues some time ago.

You can see all recommendations on my LinkedIn Profile.
